No code samples, no privilege/RBAC content.

cross_component_finding: This page's 'the Couchbase Shell is maintained by Couchbase, but it is not covered by support' is the one statement in this entire 11-page batch about support/maintenance tiering for an access surface (capella:cbsh) - worth flagging since it doesn't appear on the cbsh-heavy creating-data/reading-data/updating-data/deleting-data/bulk-operations pages that otherwise use cbsh in nearly every code example without repeating this caveat. Not a contradiction, just an inconsistency in where a support-relevant caveat is stated once rather than repeated alongside every cbsh example.
